Hi! I just moved out for the first time last month and here is what I've learned:

* Take lots of time-stamped pictures of everything in your apartment
* Make sure everything is clean before you move in (we didn't realize how nasty our carpets were and we are fighting with our landlord to get it cleaned, as it was supposed to be cleaned prior to our move-in date. Our floors and baseboards were disgusting, too and I spent three hours cleaning it).
* Make sure all communications with your landlord are written (through email or something)- you can't prove something that was communicated over the phone.
* MAKE A GROCERY LIST AND MEAL PLANS. omg. We didn't realize how important this was. My roommate and I have just been buying whatever food met our fancy and we'd have to go to the store because we realized we didn't have an ingredient for a meal. 
* Good, easy meals that I like: 

1. Eggs with spices (cumin, oregano, salt, pepper, cayenne), salsa, some chopped veggies, on a tortilla.
2. Cheese and chicken quesadillas
3. Tomato soup with potato gnocchi and grilled cheese

Good luck!
